'''Cascade Company''' was a [[Company/Legends|company]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that fought against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
Cascade Company [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|fought]] on the surface of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] to defend the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] that lived there. They were under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
